_doc: Per-project Commands V2 ship config. Lives at <project-root>/.grux/ship-config.json. Without this file, Phase 5 (publish) refuses to run rather than guess at signing identities. Copy this template and fill in the concrete values for each iOS app.
_ascAppId: App Store Connect numeric app id (the ASC URL ends with this). Required.
_bundleId: iOS bundle identifier. Must match the .pbxproj's PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER for the Release config.
_teamId: Apple Developer team id (10-char). Used in xcodebuild DEVELOPMENT_TEAM. Required.
_ascApiKey: App Store Connect API key. Required for publish + status checks. Path is relative to project root; can also live at ~/.appstoreconnect/private_keys/.
_distSigningIdentity: Codesign identity used by xcodebuild -exportArchive. Must exist in the local keychain. Run `security find-identity -v -p codesigning` to confirm.
_distProvisioningProfile: Provisioning profile name (NOT UUID, the human-readable name shown in Xcode). The .mobileprovision file should be installed via Xcode or `cp ~/Downloads/foo.mobileprovision ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/`.
_infoPlistPath: Path to the main target's Info.plist (relative to project root). The publish phase bumps CFBundleShortVersionString + CFBundleVersion here.
_subTargetPlists: Optional list of additional Info.plist files (widget, watch app, share extension) that need synchronized version bumps. Paths relative to project root.
_submissionOrchestrator: Path to the project's submission orchestrator script (relative to project root). Some projects version this per release, for example asc-fix-04-submit-<version>.js. Must accept no args and read its config from env vars or this file.
